title: Retail Price & MAP Watch
summary: Portfolio demo for brands: monitor reseller prices and MAP violations with less alert noise and fewer false matches.
problem: Brands need to watch reseller pricing and minimum advertised price (MAP) policy, but common pain points—seen in real Upwork posts and reviews of tools like Prisync—include alert noise, wrong product matches, and false MAP violations from coupons or bundles.
solution: Self-built portfolio demo (coffee equipment niche) for automation, scraping, and dashboards. Uses synthetic retailers (not live merchant data). Features include product matching with a review queue, a MAP board with evidence, alert rules with thresholds and confirmation, source health monitoring, and CSV export. Demo configuration: 60 tracked SKUs; the demo run spans 14 days. 3,133 change signals detected in the demo run; only 2 alerts pushed after thresholds and confirmation. 3,131 change signals suppressed over the last 7 days (noise filtered before alert rules). 1 open MAP violation and 1 MAP trap filtered.

zh.title: 零售价与 MAP 监控
zh.summary: 给品牌方用的作品集演示：监控渠道商价格和最低广告价（MAP）违规，少推噪音提醒，少误判同款。
zh.problem: 品牌要看渠道商价格和 MAP 政策。真实的 Upwork 单子和 Prisync 这类工具的差评里，常见痛点是提醒太多、产品匹配错、优惠券或套装造成的假违规。
zh.solution: 自建作品集演示（咖啡设备品牌），对应自动化、爬虫和仪表盘。用的是合成零售商，不是真实商家数据。功能：产品匹配加人工复核队列、带证据的 MAP 看板、带阈值和确认的提醒规则、数据源健康状态、CSV 导出。演示配置：跟踪 60 个 SKU，演示跑了 14 天。演示期间检测到 3,133 次变动，经过阈值和确认后只推了 2 条提醒。最近 7 天抑制了 3,131 次变动（进入提醒规则之前就过滤掉）。1 条未关闭的 MAP 违规，1 条 MAP 陷阱被过滤。
